title: Space Chatter - Master settings (requires Edge or Cloud voice provider(s))
Space Chatter on/off
desc: If you have one or more Cloud voice providers set up, EDCoPilot can randomly assign voices to NPC and Commanders and play their messages in those voices. IMPORTANT REMINDER: You are responsible for usage charges on your Cloud voice account. EDCoPilot will warn you when monthly free quota thresholds are met, and you can disable this feature if you are going to exceed your free quota, or continue usage and be billed accordingly.

title: Mute Chatter when Ship is muted
desc: If ON then no Space Chatter will be heard while the Ship AI is muted.

title: Detect language on/off
desc: If on, will attempt to detect the language of the incoming message, and use an appropriate languaged voice.

title: Language affinity code
desc: If this is not NONE and the language detected is not English, will override the language code to the selected value and pick a corresponding voice

title: Station Chatter - chatter around or in stations, heard in ship
Station chatter on/off
desc: Whether to generate random chatter around stations

title: Station chatter density
desc: Affects the frequency of station chatter. The higher the number, the less frequent the chatter

title: Station chatter humor on/off
desc: Include some humorous messages in the chatter

title: GalNet chatter on/off
desc: Include chatter about recent GalNet articles

title: Station chatter Fleet Carrier greetings on/off
desc: Whether your own Fleet Carrier will give you VIP messages when docking and leaving the Fleet Carrier

title: Fleet Carrier greeting levels for visitors
desc: *NEW* EDCoPilot Commanders visiting your carrier will hear greetings based on if they are a VIP, in wing, in same faction or same squadron. This is a list of comma delimted values. ALL means visitors will get a general greeting if not other criteria met, or you can add Commander names who will then be greeted like VIPs

title: Social Space Chatter - additional chatter and broadcast ads heard in station concourse and bar areas.
Social Space chatter on/off
desc: Whether to generate random chatter when in station concourse and bar area

title: Social Space chatter density
desc: Affects the frequency of Social Space chatter. The higher the number, the less frequent the chatter

title: Social Space Advertisements on/off
desc: Whether to simulate additional advertisements when in station concourse and bar area

title: Social Space Advertisements density
desc: Affects the frequency of Social Space advertisements. The higher the number, the less frequent the ads

title: Crew Chatter - simulates conversations between 5 crew roles in ship
Crew Chatter on/off
desc: Whether to simulate crew and their chatter

title: Crew Chatter density
desc: Affects the frequency of crew chatter. The higher the number, the less frequent the chatter

title: Crew Chatter minimum interval (seconds)
desc: The minimum time allowed between each crew conversation

title: Deep Space Chatter - simulates deep space themed conversations between Crew, EDCoPilot, and the occasional ship
Deep Space Chatter on/off
desc: Whether to simulate Deep Space chatter

title: Deep Space Chatter density
desc: Affects the frequency of Deep Space chatter. The higher the number, the less frequent the chatter (1 in x chance of firing each time selected)

title: Deep Space Chatter minimum interval (seconds)
desc: The minimum time allowed between each deep space chatter conversation
